name: image-delegation
description: Keep the main agent at 0 images. Screenshots, image files and PDF figures are viewed only by fresh image-inspector subagents, each with an explicit image budget. A guard hook enforces this for model servers that cap images per request.

hard_limit.title: Hard image limit per context
hard_limit.description: Maximum images the model server accepts in one request. Because the history is re-sent, this is also the lifetime cap of each context. Enforced by the guard hook.

default_budget.title: Default IMAGE_BUDGET per inspector
default_budget.description: Image budget used when a delegation does not state one. Keep it below the hard limit so crops and re-checks have a margin.
